from pathlib import Path
import textwrap, importlib.util
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    counts = Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg = [(n, c) for c, n in counts.items() if c != bg]
    if not fg:
        return g
    # A repeated line/shape color is the signal; isolated colored cells are not.
    n, color = max(fg)
    if n < 3:
        return g
    pts = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == color}
    # Extend each endpoint of each 8-connected same-color stroke along its tangent.
    unseen = set(pts)
    while unseen:
        start = unseen.pop()
        comp = {start}
        q = [start]
        while q:
            r, c = q.pop()
            for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
                for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
                    p = (r + dr, c + dc)
                    if (dr or dc) and p in unseen:
                        unseen.remove(p); comp.add(p); q.append(p)
        if len(comp) < 3:
            continue
        for r, c in list(comp):
            neighbors = [(rr, cc) for rr, cc in comp if max(abs(rr-r), abs(cc-c)) == 1]
            if len(neighbors) != 1:
                continue
            rr, cc = neighbors[0]
            dr, dc = r-rr, c-cc
            nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
            while 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and g[nr][nc] == bg:
                g[nr][nc] = color
                nr += dr; nc += dc
    return g
'''
p=base/'task-208d9784.py'; p.write_text(code)
# load and validate demo pair
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',p); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

demo_out=[[9]*27 for _ in range(14)]
for r,c,v in [(4,26,8),(5,25,8),(6,24,8),(7,23,8),(8,22,8),(9,21,8),(10,20,8),(11,18,0),(11,19,8),(12,18,0),(12,19,8),(13,20,8)]: demo_out[r][c]=v
pred=mod.transform(demo_in)
print('pair reproduces',pred==demo_out)
